levels.title: 关卡 20: 猜数字游戏
levels.description: 创建一个完整的猜数字游戏！
levels.example:
# 猜数字游戏
import random

number = random.randint(1, 100)
guess = 0
attempts = 0

while guess != number:
    guess = int(input("猜一个数字: "))
    attempts += 1
    if guess < number:
        print("太小了！")
    elif guess > number:
        print("太大了！")
    else:
        print(f"恭喜！你用了{attempts}次猜对了！")

levels.title: 关卡 25: 日记系统
levels.description: 创建一个简单的日记管理系统！
levels.example:
# 日记系统
from datetime import datetime

def write_diary():
    date = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
    content = input("请输入日记内容: ")
    with open("diary.txt", "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(f"{date}\n{content}\n---\n")
    print("日记已保存！")
